post.description:

name.description: Package name as the registry knows it: npm `express` or `@types/node`; PyPI `requests` (any PEP 503 spelling); crate `serde`; Maven `groupId:artifactId` such as `com.google.guava:guava`.

registry.description:
Which registry the name belongs to: npm (registry.npmjs.org), pypi (pypi.org), crates (crates.io) or maven (Maven Central).

Provider reference: allowed values ["npm", "pypi", "crates", "maven"].

sample.description:
crates only: how many dependent crates to list by name (0 to 100).

Provider reference: minimum 0; maximum 100; default 20.

version.description: Exact version to count dependents for, e.g. 5.1.0 or 33.4.8-jre. Default: the registry's default (latest) version.

200.description:

The response contains the tool result directly.

| --- | --- | --- |
| `registry` | string |  |

| `count` | number | deps.dev: packages whose resolved graph includes this version, or null. |
| `direct` | number |  |
| `indirect` | number |  |
| `scope` | string | Always version. |
| `package_dependents` | object | crates only: {count, scope: package, source: crates.io, source_url}; null elsewhere. |

| `sources` | string[] |  |
| `registry_url` | string | Human page for the package on its registry. |
| `source_url` | string | The primary API URL that answered. |
| `warnings` | string[] | Secondary sources that failed or caveats on the numbers. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number | Unix milliseconds when fetched. |

period.description:

name.description: Package name as the registry knows it: npm `express` or `@types/node`; PyPI `requests` (any PEP 503 spelling); crate `serde`; Maven `groupId:artifactId` such as `com.google.guava:guava`.

registry.description:
Which registry the name belongs to: npm (registry.npmjs.org), pypi (pypi.org), crates (crates.io) or maven (Maven Central).

Provider reference: allowed values ["npm", "pypi", "crates", "maven"].

200.description:
One package's current record: latest version and publish time, description, license, homepage/repository/issues links, keywords, version count, a download summary (npm and PyPI last week/month; crates.io last week/month/90 days/total; Maven Central publishes none) and a dependent count.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `registry` | string | npm, pypi, crates or maven. |
| `name` | string | Normalised name (PyPI PEP 503 normalised, npm lowercased, Maven groupId:artifactId). |
| `display_name` | string | The registry's own spelling or Maven project name; null when none. |
| `description` | string |  |
| `latest_version` | string | The registry's current default version. |
| `latest_published_at` | string | ISO 8601 publish time of latest_version, or null. |
| `license` | string | Primary licence identifier or name as published, or null. |
| `licenses` | string[] | Every licence named by the registry or deps.dev. |
| `homepage` | string |  |
| `repository` | string |  |
| `documentation` | string |  |
| `issues` | string |  |
| `keywords` | string[] |  |
| `version_count` | number | Published versions, or null. |
| `created_at` | string | First publish time known to the source, or null. |
| `updated_at` | string | Most recent publish or update time, or null. |
| `deprecated` | boolean | npm: whether latest is deprecated; null elsewhere. |
| `yanked` | boolean | PyPI/crates: whether latest is yanked; null elsewhere. |
